_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

phase_hours.basis: the 480-hour phase maintenance interval the networks predicted actions for, in testing

restored_pct.basis: percent of missing and corrupted flight data restored, in testing

restored_of_100.basis: restored_pct cells of a 100 cell drawing grid, a drawing unit

grid_cells.basis: the drawing grid for restored_of_100, a rule not a count

volume_cut_pct.basis: ceiling on data volume reduction, up to

files_cut_pct.basis: ceiling on data file reduction, up to

partner_since.basis: year IMMS and AVX began partnering

tools.basis: the two tools provided to the Army, FSUI and PSV
